# Studio San Francisco

> A recording studio in San Francisco, CA, built for solo artists, bands, and creative projects. Recording sessions from $60/hr, artist passes as low as $45/hr, and custom audio/video project estimates within 24 hours. Founded by Stephen, a songwriter and recording engineer.

Last updated: 2026-07-17

## About

Studio San Francisco is an independent recording space located inside Secret Studios in San Francisco, CA 94124. Full address is shared upon booking. The studio is designed for Bay Area artists who need a focused, collaborative environment with a professional engineer included in every session. The studio specializes in capturing clean takes, human performances, and full-production recordings, plus video production (testimonial videos, filmed artist features, live performance capture).

## How Pricing Works (core logic)

Every estimate is built from two simple rates:

- **$60/hr when the client is in the room** - recording sessions, tracking, working side by side ($75/hr for bands of 3+ people)
- **$40/hr when Stephen works alone** - editing, mixing, session prep, added instrumentation/drum tracking
- **On-location and specialized builds** (mobile recording, video shoots, live performance capture) are scoped per project with an itemized estimate

Clients with a project idea can describe it on the website and receive a personal, no-obligation estimate within 24 hours.

## Services

- **Launch Intro Session** - $75, 2 hours, engineer included, full backline, quick mix included. Entry point for all new clients.
- **Recording Sessions** - Engineer-led precision tracking for vocals, instruments, and full arrangements. From $60/hr (off-peak $50/hr, late-nite $75/hr).
- **Band Rehearsal Capture** - Live rehearsal recording (up to 8 inputs, up to 5 headphone mixes), $75/hr, 3-hour minimum.
- **Artist Passes** - Prepaid studio-hour packages: 8 hrs = $50/hr, 16 hrs = $47.50/hr, 24 hrs = $45/hr.
- **Mixing & Stems (add-ons)** - Final mix $150/song (2 revision rounds). Organized final stems $75/song. Every session includes a rough mix at no charge.
- **Podcast Production** - Full production in-studio or on-location, $200/hr (2-hr minimum).
- **Mobile Recording** - Professional recording gear brought to your space, $100/hr (4-hr minimum).
- **Video Production** - Testimonial/brand videos from $650 in-studio (from $800 Bay Area on-location); Artist Feature filmed interview $300; Tiny Desk-style live performance capture scoped per project.
- **Next-Gig Content Capture** - $250: photo + video coverage of a live show with edited deliverables.

## Typical Project Costs

- Record a single (tracked with engineer + final mix): typically $350–$650
- Band demo / live capture session (3 hrs + labeled multitrack exports): typically $225–$400
- Produced podcast episode: typically $400–$800
- Filmed Artist Feature (interview + highlight clip): $300
- Testimonial/brand video: from $650
- Live performance video (Tiny Desk-style): scoped on a quick call
- A $50 deposit is required to confirm session time (applied to final total)
- Currency: USD

## Booking

All new clients start with Quick-Start - a free planning call (phone, coffee, or studio visit) or a $75 intro session. Clients with a custom project idea can request an estimate and receive a personal reply within 24 hours. After submitting an intake form, clients select a time on Calendly.

Book at: https://www.bookthestudiosf.com/#quick-start
Get an estimate: https://www.bookthestudiosf.com/#estimate

## Brew in the Stu (video series)

Brew in the Stu is a video series filmed inside Studio San Francisco during a 30-day season: coffee, music, and real moments from a working recording studio, made by Stephen. Watch at https://www.bookthestudiosf.com/brew.html or on YouTube at https://www.youtube.com/@thestudio_sf
